comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Implemented backup-only session enforcement: Smb2Client.RequiredCreateOptions propagated to sessions and ORed into all create requests; TBO provider sets OpenForBackupIntent on its Smb2Client. Added ISmb2TraceCallback hook to verify SeBackupPrivilege/SeRestorePrivilege via LSARPC over the authenticated session (IPC$) and fail fast with a clear error if missing. Build ok (existing warnings).

comments.author: Jim Sykora
comments.text: Added auto-grant flow: LSARPC adds SeBackupPrivilege/SeRestorePrivilege on missing accounts (open or create LSA account with AdjustPrivileges), marks session for reauth, and Smb2Client now retries authentication once when a session requests reauth. Added InternalsVisibleTo for TBO access to Smb2Session.RequiresReauth. Build ok (existing warnings).
